editorial.headline: Air Force Activities Are Closed to Foreign Investment
editorial.standfirst: This activity covers the Air Force’s administrative and operational environment and is closed to PMA nationwide, including in Bali.
editorial.body:
KBLI 84223 concerns the Air Force as an institutional activity rather than a commercial service category. Its scope embraces the full range of administrative, operational and other work carried out within the Air Force environment. It expressly includes civilian employees working there. The boundary matters too: Air Force members who are employed or hold government positions, including the Air Force headquarters cited in the scope, are excluded.

There are no business scales listed as open for this activity. That sits alongside its national PMA classification of TERTUTUP: foreign investment is closed, with a maximum foreign ownership ceiling of 0%. A foreign investor therefore has no PMA registration route under this activity nationally. This is not a matter of selecting a smaller or larger operating scale; the record provides neither an open scale nor foreign ownership capacity.

Bali reaches the same practical conclusion. The Bali status is TERTUTUP and the activity is marked as blocked for PMA registration, meaning a foreign investor cannot register it in Bali today. The reason needs to be read precisely. The activity is identified as medium-high or high risk, and its Bali restriction is not attributed to the province-wide moratorium. That moratorium permanently blocks all low- and medium-low-risk activities for PMA across the island; this record instead calls for verification by address.

For founders, the clarity lies in holding both layers at once. The national position is already closed to PMA, and Bali also records the activity as closed and blocked. Bali’s risk and address-verification note explains the local treatment; it does not create an alternative foreign-investment route. The scope should therefore be read narrowly, as a description of the Air Force institutional environment and its civilian workforce, within a category unavailable to foreign ownership.
editorial.pullQuote: A foreign investor has no PMA registration route under this activity nationally or in Bali.
